```yaml
---
id: vuln-novnc-ad941fad
languages:
  - javascript
message: Vulnerable code detected in WebUtil.createCookie()
metadata:
  cwe: CWE-310 (Cryptographic Issues)
  cvss_score: 7.5
  description: |
    The vulnerability is caused by the use of a weak cryptographic mechanism to encrypt sensitive data. An attacker who can read the encrypted data can potentially gain unauthorized access to sensitive information.
  remediation: Upgrade to a secure cryptographic library or implementation.
severity: WARNING
pattern: |
  (func-name=WebUtil\.createCookie)
  (args=(name,value,days))
  (body=
    (var-decl=date,expires)
    (if-stmt=
      (cond=(days))
      (then=
        (set=date=new Date())
        (set=date.setTime(date.getTime()+(days*24*60*60*1000)))
        (set=expires="; expires="+date.toGMTString())
      )
      (else=
        (set=expires="")
      )
    )
    (set=document.cookie=name+"="+value+expires+"; path=/")
  )
```
